claim: Gobel's n = 5 packing is infinitesimally flexible and second-order rigid. This repository's own evidence, and a finer statement than the catalogue's bare "Rigid."
claim_boundary: Both the rank and the walk are numerical, at the retained pose. This is not the n = 11 result: there is no branchwise tangent-cone argument and no exact field here. It is consistent with local rigidity and does not establish it, and no frontier record was changed -- a rigidity property is a promotion, and an unattended runner applies the accept rule only conservatively.

escape_screen.why_insufficient: The screen exhibits single-square translations only. A miss is weak evidence: rotations and coordinated multi-square motion are outside it, so it is consistent with rigidity and cannot establish it.

first_party_evidence.scope_of_that_dimension: all squares, all coordinates and the side -- not only single-square translations, so this closes the gap the escape screen leaves at first order
first_party_evidence.why_the_gap_matters: Fifty decades between the smallest counted and the largest discarded singular value, so the dimension is a property of the packing rather than of the rank tolerance.
first_party_evidence.free_direction: a rotation of the centre square about its own centre

recommendation_for_a_reviewer.scope: the unique first-order flex at the retained pose, and its second-order obstruction
recommendation_for_a_reviewer.not_applied_here: A rigidity property is a promotion through the evidence contract, and this runner may not make it.

n28_and_n40.why: Everything above needs a contact structure. The atlas retains contact structures for n = 11 and n = 29 only, and neither n = 28 nor n = 40 has a case module. Producing the same evidence means extracting a structure from the retained witness first, which the promotion pipeline can now do and which is a block of its own rather than a re-run of this one.
n28_and_n40.escape_screen: the same negative result as n = 5: no movable square, zero separating squares, stable across tolerances

reproduce: uv run --frozen --all-extras --group dev python -m devtools.probe_contact_system --case gobel5 --walk
